title: Trace after restriction on an object with a split pullback cover
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be finite étale [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $W\to X$ be a small étale-site object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Suppose a finite index set $J$ and maps $i_j:D_j\to Y\times_X W$ [def-pc-fibre-product] exhibit that scheme as a coproduct, each $i_j$ is an open and closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], and each composite $D_j\to W$ is an isomorphism. The component on $F(W)$ of restriction followed by trace [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace] is $|J|\operatorname{id}_{F(W)}$. No degree, connectedness, nonemptiness, or positivity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction and leftAdjointUniq unit compatibility to express restriction on W as restriction along W×_X Y→W. Apply the localization property of the chosen trace to W→X; pullback symmetry and pasting identify the local pullback with Y×_X W.

Invert each component projection to obtain a section. The split property of existsUnique_finiteEtaleTrace expresses the localized trace as the sum of restrictions along the sections. The restriction along the projection composed with each section contribution is the identity by contravariant functoriality. Composition distributes over the finite sum, so the composite is |J| times identity. Cancel the localization isomorphisms. The empty sum is zero and the empty covering forces sections over an empty object to vanish.

theorem finiteEtaleTrace_comp_restriction_app_of_split
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (W : X.Etale)
    (J : Type u) [Fintype J] (D : J → Scheme.{u})
    (i : ∀ j, D j ⟶ pullback f W.hom)
    (_ : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f W.hom) i)))
    (_ : ∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (i j))
    (_ : ∀ j, IsIso (i j ≫ pullback.snd f W.hom)) :
    (finiteEtaleRestriction f F ≫ finiteEtaleTrace f F).hom.app (op W) =
      Fintype.card J • 𝟙 (F.obj.obj (op W))
